verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a self-hosted AI runtime like LocalAI, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documentation of vendor telemetry, or of any flag or setting to disable it. The only 'usage tracking' mention is the operator-side per-user metering enabled by LOCALAI_AUTH=true, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for a telemetry opt-out.
